name: hd_fs30_v2_pilotE
notes: PILOT E (docs/FS_PILOT.md): post-warmup mixing only. Pilots A-D were aborted under their pre-set rules because the warmup itself (step-size dual averaging; A/B also metric adaptation from the overdispersed init) drives at least one of the 8 lockstep chains to tree depth 10 (1023 steps, 164 s per 8-chain iteration) in most iterations after the first ~8, with unit, diagonal or dense metric alike. E skips adaptation: 8 chains from 8 random draws of the M2 run hd_fs30 (seed 31), fixed dense metric = hd_fs30's pooled z-covariance, FIXED step size 0.025 (M2 hd_fs30 adapted 0.026-0.030 with a similar dense metric), 1 non-adapting warmup iteration, 100 draws. Same model, fast exact likelihood, target tree depth. NOT independent of hd_fs30; measures 8-chain transition rates, ESS per gradient and IRN behaviour in the regime v2 would reach after a successful warmup (with a dense rather than diagonal metric). Stop rule (fixed before launch): stop at the last 25-draw checkpoint ending before 12:30 UTC on 2026-10-08 (~2 h total pilot GPU time A-E).
